title: Corona spy satellite program offered as explanation for Vallee's sighting

tellings.quote: sighting by invoking the Corona program, a series of highly secretive CIA-sponsored satellites first launched in 1960, kicking off the modern era of orbital espionage. The Corona satellites did have a nearly polar orbit. However, it's a very insufficient explanation.

related.note: Offers the CIA Corona spy satellites as the explanation for the same orbiting object in telling 3, which is a different core claim about what the light was.

plain: When the astronomer Jacques Vallée, as a young man at the Paris Observatory, tracked an object circling Earth in an unusual orbit, some later explained the sighting as one of the Corona satellites, a series of highly secret CIA spy satellites first launched in 1960. Michels tells this himself, in an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, and grants that the Corona satellites "did have a nearly polar orbit" but calls it "a very insufficient explanation", which would leave Vallée's object unexplained.
